title: Pure Destiny HERO
summary: The page's Destiny-focused build: its recommended copies of the Beyond the Brave cards, the classic Destiny HERO core, Polymerization, and generic staples. Doom Overlord and Fusion Destiny lock you into DARK HERO monsters for the turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord is the one-card starter: on summon it banishes a monster until the next Standby Phase, then mills a Destiny HERO such as Malicious to add Dark City at Midnight or Clock Tower Prison.
Dark City at Midnight searches a Destiny HERO card on activation, and when destroyed it Special Summons a Destiny HERO such as Dreadmaster directly from the Deck.

Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Destiny HERO or Field Spell, then destroys Dark City at Midnight or Clock Tower Prison to search Polymerization.

summary.title: Opening: Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord
steps: Summon Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord and activate its effect to mill Destiny HERO - Malicious and add Dark City at Midnight from the Deck.
Activate Dark City at Midnight to search Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant, Special Summon Dreadnought Servant, and use it to destroy Dark City at Midnight and search Polymerization.
Dark City at Midnight's destruction effect Special Summons Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster from the Deck, which revives up to two Destiny HEROes from the GY.

Tribute Dreadmaster to Special Summon Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Master from the Extra Deck, searching two more Destiny HERO cards, then use Malicious, Denier, and Polymerization or Fusion Destiny to establish your Fusion board.

summary.title: GY Recursion & Tribute Engine
summary.text: Destiny HERO - Malicious banishes itself from the GY to summon its second copy from the Deck, and Destiny HERO - Denier stacks a banished Malicious back on top of the Deck while reviving itself once per Duel so Malicious can be used a third time. Reviving Destiny HERO - Disk Commander draws 2 cards, while three bodies on board can Tribute Summon Destiny HERO - Plasma to negate every opposing face-up monster and equip one for ATK.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer lowers opposing monsters' ATK, destroys one of your cards and one card on the field as a Quick Effect on either turn, and revives a Destiny HERO every Standby Phase.

Destiny HERO - Dystopia inflicts burn damage on summon and destroys a card on the field as a Quick Effect whenever its current ATK differs from its original ATK, which Dark City at Midnight and D - Tactics trigger.

Destiny HERO - Dominance stacks the top 3 cards of either Deck and floats into three Level 9 or lower Destiny HEROes from the GY when destroyed, while Destiny End Dragoon destroys a monster, burns, and revives itself.
Masked HERO Dark Law banishes every card sent to the opponent's GY and rips a card from their hand when they add a card outside the Draw Phase.
Destiny HERO - Destro-Dogma banishes three Warrior or DARK monsters from the GY to summon itself and Fusion Summons a Destiny HERO Fusion during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left out
points: Fusion Destiny Fusion Summons a Destiny HERO directly from the hand and Deck, destroying it in the next End Phase so Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer immediately sets up its own revival.
Destiny Draw discards a Destiny HERO such as Malicious, Denier, or Disk Commander to draw 2 cards.
D - Tactics boosts your HEROes each Standby Phase, banishes a card from the opponent's hand, field, or GY whenever a Level 8+ Destiny HERO arrives, and searches a Destiny HERO if destroyed.
D-Fusion Fusion Summons using only Destiny HERO monsters you control as a Trap and protects the summoned Fusion from destruction that turn.
Left out: The Vision, Elemental, Masked, and Xtra HERO engines of the Omni-HERO build are omitted so this list stays pure to Destiny HERO.
